parsed.notes: Lens B only; support and quote-fidelity merits were not reviewed except where a support-labeled assertion made a current treatment/currency classification.

reasons: The lake identity and citation fields confirm the cited Fourth Circuit en banc authority, official citation 846 F.3d 694, year 2017, and vendor citations 2017 WL 280727 and 2017 U.S. App. LEXIS 1134.
No disclosed treatment edge reports overruling, abrogation, supersession, or limitation of the cited authority.
residual_risks: The lake record does not affirmatively verify current good-law status: treatment is unverified, treatment as-of fields are null, and progeny enumeration is absent.
The lake record discloses a canonical-caption mismatch accepted by the identity process.
reviewed.suggested_tightening: Keep the Treatment: Unverified warning adjacent to the citation whenever this authority is rendered.

reasons: Lens B found no disclosed negative-treatment edge that would make the stated Robinson holding obsolete.
The page separately labels treatment as Unverified, so it does not present the holding as citator-verified good law.
residual_risks: Support and quote fidelity are outside Lens B and not reviewed here.
Current good-law status remains unverified because the lake treatment and progeny fields are frontier-stub fields.
reviewed.suggested_tightening: Do not render this holding as nationally settled or citator-verified unless treatment is later promoted.

defect.evidence_quote: Frontier stub: treatment/progeny intentionally not derived until S6 promotion.
defect.problem: The home role labels Robinson as illustrating a circuit split, but the disclosed treatment/progeny record does not verify a current split or include authority records for the alleged opposite-side cases.
defect.proposed_fix: Remove or demote the circuit-split home role unless disclosed treatment/progeny data or included authority records verify the current split; otherwise use a narrower role such as 'Discusses armed-and-dangerous frisk rule.'

reasons: The only lake treatment status is unverified, with edges empty and progeny rows_cached equal to 0.
The disclosed universe contains no lake/text records for Northrup or Black to verify the asserted opposite side of the split.
residual_risks: The circuit split may be real, but it is not verifiable from this disclosed review group.
reviewed.suggested_tightening: Add disclosed authority records or current citator treatment for the split cases before using a circuit-split role.

reasons: The treatment payload matches the lake treatment fields: field_i_validity unverified, composite_basis unverified, as_of_content null, as_of_treatment null, varies_by_point false.
The lake scope note expressly states that treatment/progeny were intentionally not derived.
residual_risks: This verifies only the unverified treatment status, not Robinson's current good-law status.

reasons: The lake identity identifies the authority as the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Fourth Circuit en banc, with court_level coa and circuit ca4.
No disclosed treatment edge says the decision has been overruled, abrogated, superseded, or limited, and the page separately flags treatment as Unverified.
residual_risks: Because treatment is unverified, current binding effect is not citator-confirmed.
The label should be read as in-circuit precedential weight, not as verified good-law treatment.
reviewed.suggested_tightening: When authority_weight is rendered without the treatment badge, append a treatment-unverified qualifier.
